name: install_git
title: Install a package from a git repository

origin.description: Clone a git repository and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
origin.usage: install_git(url, subdir = NULL, ref = NULL, branch = NULL, credentials = git_credentials(), git = c("auto", "git2r", "external"), dependencies = NA, quiet = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: url
arguments.text: Git URL. A file:// URL of a local repository is accepted. A trailing @ref selects the ref.

arguments.name: ref
arguments.text: Branch, tag, or commit. branch is the deprecated name of ref.

arguments.name: git
arguments.text: auto uses an external git client when git2r is not installed. git2r is an error when that package is absent.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: The clone is shallow. RemoteType xgit is written into DESCRIPTION. The URL is parsed with the same unanchored pattern as remotes.
origin.value: The package name, or a character vector of names.
origin.example: install_git(url, dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, build = FALSE, lib = lib, git = "external")

translation.description: Clone a git repository and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
translation.usage: install_git(url, subdir=None, ref=None, branch=None, credentials=None, git='auto', dependencies=NA, quiet=False, lib=None)

arguments.name: url
arguments.text: Git URL. file:// keeps the path. A path without a scheme is parsed by the same unanchored expression.

arguments.name: git
arguments.text: external runs git clone --depth 1. auto uses external when git2r is not installed.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The bundle is downloaded with urllib and installed with R CMD INSTALL into lib. A check uses a fresh temporary library and does not write to ~/R/library. Submodules are updated with git submodule update --init --recursive when .gitmodules is present.
translation.example: install_git(url, dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, build=False, lib=lib, git="external")
